description: Transparent, editable rule configuration for Face Check Bite v1 (rule-based, no AI diagnosis).

oily.label: Oily Skin
oily.explanation: Your sebaceous glands produce extra sebum, especially across the T-zone in humid or warm weather. Gel cleansers, oil-free hydration, and matte UV filters keep shine balanced without stripping.

dry.label: Dry Skin
dry.explanation: Your skin loses moisture faster and benefits from non-foaming amino cleansers, lipid-rich ceramide creams, and nourishing sun protection.

combination.label: Combination Skin
combination.explanation: You experience oiliness on the forehead and nose alongside normal or drier cheeks. Balanced pH cleansers and lightweight layers prevent congestion without parching cheeks.

normal.label: Normal Skin
normal.explanation: Your oil and hydration levels are naturally balanced. A consistent 3-step cleanse, moisturize, and SPF habit preserves clarity and prevents early pigmentation.

sensitive.label: Sensitive Skin
sensitive.explanation: Your skin reacts quickly to harsh surfactants, strong acids, or fragrance. Gentle oat-based cleansing, ceramide barrier care, and soothing UV protection come first.

acne.label: Acne & Breakouts
acne.reason: 5% Niacinamide + Zinc PCA helps calm active redness and regulate pore-clogging oil.

oiliness.label: Excess Oil & Shine
oiliness.reason: Zinc PCA and 5% Niacinamide rebalance excess surface sebum through humid Indian afternoons.

pigmentation.label: Pigmentation & Dark Spots
pigmentation.reason: 2% Alpha Arbutin targets uneven melanin patches and post-acne marks gently.

dullness.label: Dullness & Uneven Tone
dullness.reason: Stable Vitamin C + Ferulic Acid revives tired skin exposed to urban dust and sun.

dryness.label: Dryness & Flaking
dryness.reason: Hydrating hyaluronic acid + cica supports plumpness without drying exfoliants.

sensitivity.label: Redness & Sensitivity
sensitivity.reason: Cica-led soothing support calms reactivity without harsh acids or fragrance.
